evidence.note: After compile-checking imports and starting the cluster, the agent probed /api/health on all 3 nodes, registered/logged in, created workspaces cross-node, and posted messages from different nodes — then explicitly listed messages to confirm seq density across HTTP nodes. Genuine multi-node HTTP happy-path + invariant checking.

Wrote reusable test scripts (wstest.py, irctest.py): verified WebSocket subscribe and cross-node fan-out, then IRC join/privmsg, and confirmed the IRC-posted message landed at seq=5 — directly verifying the key invariant of dense per-channel seq under MIXED HTTP+IRC writers. This is an anchor-8-level invariant check.
UI verification was only a curl of the served HTML/JS ('UI serves') — never driven by a browser/Playwright against the pinned testids, despite playwright being available.
Planned and began the resilience test: killed node 0 (kill -9), intended to confirm nodes 1/2 keep serving writes with dense seq, then kill the broadcaster. This is the right adversarial intent.

Terminal wedged immediately after the kill; the agent never confirmed nodes 1/2 answered post-kill, never ran the broadcaster-kill test at all, and after ~30 stuck steps declared the task complete on the ASSUMPTION resilience works rather than restarting a fresh shell/service. Resume/resume.gap also never explicitly tested. The critical failure-injection verification was omitted.

reasoning: The agent exercised each subsystem's main paths (HTTP across nodes, WS subscribe+fan-out, IRC join/privmsg, UI served) and, beyond a bare level-5, directly verified two hard invariants: dense per-channel seq under mixed HTTP+IRC writers and cross-node WebSocket fan-out. That pushes it above 5. But it falls well short of 8: the SPA was only curled (never browser-driven against testids), resume.gap/replay-on-reconnect were not verified, error-code coverage was thin, and — most critically for this dimension — the resilience scenarios were never confirmed (node-kill attempt was foiled by a terminal freeze and the broadcaster-kill was never run), with the agent ultimately assuming resilience works. This lands between the level-5 and level-8 anchors, at 6.
